revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, showing a paved campus walkway beside a building. Scene includes benches, planted edges, painted loading-bay concrete, a safety rail, and a distant worker-shaped silhouette that is not the main subject. Moderate backlight balanced with usable foreground fill. Slightly distant oblique view with natural perspective, realistic scale, and enough surrounding context to judge body support. Main visible subject is a tall broad-built adult wearing a reflective work vest over neutral clothing with muted orange workwear accents, holding a forearm plank correctly with both forearms and toes supporting the body and the torso suspended above the ground, clearly visible. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
